_meta.description: Expected simulated-clock replay of Wed Oct 21 - Thu Oct 22 for the showcase. 'without_heads_up' is what the persona screenshots show; 'with_heads_up' is what the agent should do. Use it to drive the Streamlit clock and to assert the decision log in pytest. Updated Nov 24 for the call-first ladder (call at 8 AM, retry at 10 AM, family request at 1:30 PM).

with_heads_up.script: Hi Gloria, this is Heads-Up with a message from Michelle. Please pick up Ava at 2:30 today instead of 3:15, at Oakwood Elementary. Your calendar is updated and your phone will remind you at 2:00. Press 1 if you got this.

with_heads_up.subject: Today: pick up Ava at 2:30, not 3:15
with_heads_up.body_large_print:
Good morning Gloria.

Michelle sent a change last night:

PICK UP AVA AT 2:30 TODAY (not 3:15)
Oakwood Elementary. Early dismissal.

Your calendar is updated, and your phone will remind you at 2:00.

We also called you about this. If you already pressed 1 on the call, you're all set. Otherwise, please tap the button so Michelle knows you got it.
with_heads_up.note: Written record; sent with the first call

with_heads_up.detail: Message left; voicemail does not count as confirmed

with_heads_up.message: Hi Michelle, this is Heads-Up. Your mom hasn't confirmed the change to pick up Ava at 2:30 today. Please give her a call.
